steps.text: Place the blower drive support. with the inner face up. on the bed of an arbor press. Start the governor weight shaft bearing, number side up, in the bearing bore of the support. Place a sleeve against the outer race and press the bearing firmly against the shoulder in the bearing bore. Attach the bearing retainer (four- weight governor only) with two bolts, nuts and copper washers.
